Third-party browser libraries used by the Billing page, served from here so the
page does not depend on a public CDN. Versions are pinned.

- pdf.js 3.11.174 (pdfjs-dist) - Apache-2.0 - parses Ford invoice PDFs
- pdf-lib 1.17.1 - MIT - merges the billing package PDF
- SheetJS xlsx 0.18.5 - Apache-2.0 - reads the inventory workbook
